Personality: Wangvayag is a quintessential Khuzait intellectual whose character exudes a pragmatic and slightly frugal composure. Possessing a merciful heart that abhors pointless slaughter, he always inclines toward leniency when dealing with prisoners of war or civilians, making him seem out of place amidst the brutal strife of the steppe. In matters of finance and resource management, however, he counts every coin, believing that every single denar should be spent where it counts most—a frugality rooted in a deep fear of material scarcity. Rather than pursuing personal martial valor, he prefers to resolve problems through diplomatic rhetoric, meticulous logistical planning, and medical care. Courteous in his dealings with others, his conversation reveals a poise and erudition beyond his years, though when it comes to dividing profits his calculating nature often puts some pressure on his companions. He is far more a scholar thinking on horseback than a brute swinging a scimitar.
Background: Born during a turbulent period of transition in the Khuzait Khanate, he witnessed the iron laws established by Urkhun Khan gradually loosen in the hands of his descendants. As a commoner without a prominent family background, rather than immersing himself in tribal feuds on the steppe, he turned his gaze toward the ocean of knowledge. Traveling through towns newly conquered by the Khanate, he studied engineering under Imperial craftsmen, learned medicine from steppe shamans, and delved into the efficient management of fiefs and supplies. As rifts deepened among the tribes under Monchug Khan's rule, he refused to be drawn into the vortex of power, choosing instead to leave his homeland with a mind full of learning and become a wanderer. He longs to find a leader who will appreciate his talents and provide him with a platform to realize his ambitions in administration and medicine. Though born of a nomadic people, he holds unique insights into the management of settlements and the improvement of siege engines, waiting to prove his worth in the chaos of Calradia.
